_comment: Synthetic repository snapshot covering every scenario the candidate write-up names: merged, closed, reopened (folds into shared/open), moved-tip, shared-ref (duplicate tips), fork (out of scope, documented in README rather than modeled here), and protected-branch.

branches.name: feature/merged-and-clean
branches._scenario: merged: fully contained in base, PR head matches tip -> duplicate, safe to propose

branches.name: feature/still-in-review
branches._scenario: open PR -> shared, keep regardless of ancestry

branches.name: feature/reopened-after-close
branches._scenario: reopened PR reads as an ordinary open PR -> shared, same as feature/still-in-review

branches.name: feature/grew-after-pr-closed

unique_commits.message: pushed after the PR was closed, never reviewed

branches._scenario: PR closed at moved004a but branch tip is moved004b -> moved_since_closed, never read as stale-by-age

branches.name: feature/moved-after-merge

unique_commits.message: a second commit landed after merge, never shipped

branches._scenario: PR merged at moved005a but tip is moved005b -> moved_since_closed even though the PR itself merged

branches.name: chore/dup-a

unique_commits.message: duplicate push of the same fix

branches._scenario: shared-ref: identical tip to chore/dup-b, no PR on either -> duplicate (redundant), keeper is chore/dup-a alphabetically

branches.name: chore/dup-b

unique_commits.message: duplicate push of the same fix

branches._scenario: shared-ref: identical tip to chore/dup-a -> duplicate, flagged as duplicate_of chore/dup-a

branches.name: experiment/never-opened-a-pr

unique_commits.message: half-finished spike, no PR was ever opened

branches._scenario: unique commits, no PR at all -> unique_work, never proposed for deletion, always in the recovery manifest

branches.name: legacy/unknown-history
branches._scenario: ancestry could not be computed (e.g. a shallow clone) -> uncertain, never collapsed into a deletion recommendation
